name: searchTools
description: Search the full order-to-delivery operation catalog (both domains, both live tools and catalog-only operations) by a keyword in its name or description. Returns a resource link per match; read it to see whether the operation is a live tool to call or a catalog entry to read.

name: shipping_eta_get
description: Get a plain-language estimated delivery window computed from the shipment's current lifecycle status.

orderId.description: The order id, for example O-7001.

name: shipping_track_get
description: Track this shipment: its carrier, tracking number and lifecycle status, read from the shipping schema only (no order or payment data).

orderId.description: The order id, for example O-7001.
